reason: I forget pills at home and travel a lot, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is actually useful to me. At $24.99 launch price I'd try one box, but I wouldn't pay $29.99 without seeing it work first.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli and those last longer. Made in China makes me want to see that lab report for real before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: If the first box were $29.99 with no launch discount, I'd skip it. A clearly visible lab report on the page would make me more comfortable.
